grounding.excerpt: (2) Perform WET testing at first discharge.

payload.rationale: The permit clause at part_i directly requires WET testing at first discharge, which establishes event-triggered special monitoring rather than a recurring calendar-period DMR numeric limit. The adjacent monitoring schedule in the same section lists Ceriodaphnia dubia (a WET test species) with Report/Once/5 years, supporting the special-monitoring frequency described in the obligation. The packet contains no evidence that WET is subject to a monthly DMR numeric limit.
